title: Per-provider legacy assistant planner streaming toggle
observed_behavior: The legacy assistant planner attempted streaming whenever its chat client implemented AssistantStreamingChatClient, causing OpenAI-compatible providers that omit delta.content for streamed response_format (json_schema) outputs to incur a failed streaming attempt before falling back.
intended_behavior: The legacy assistant planner uses non-streaming chat completions by default and only attempts streaming when the assistant provider configuration explicitly enables assistant.llm_streaming.
authoritative_contract: Beads issue bahia-mxyg requires AssistantConfig.LLMStreaming with koanf/yaml key llm_streaming, BAHIA_ASSISTANT_LLM_STREAMING flat compatibility env loading, AssistantOrchestratorConfig.StreamingEnabled wiring, default-off non-streaming behavior, and opt-in streaming behavior. Follow-up to bahia-m6qs; the chat_client.go empty-stream fallback remains unchanged.
